meta.title: Package finder: which package fits you? | EM Launchpad
meta.ogtitle: Package finder: weighed up honestly | EM Launchpad
meta.desc: Six short questions and honest advice: Online Growth from €150 a month (excl. VAT), AI Consulting, or EML AI Team for businesses with a team.

hero.lede: Six short questions about your business. With every answer you see what we put on the other side, what we leave out and what it costs per month.
hero.facts: Six questions · no email address needed · your answers stay on your device
hero.figcap: A shop counter scale. On the left your business puts what it needs; on the right we put what covers it: Online Growth (€150 per month) and, only when it's needed, the AI chatbot (+€50) or the AI receptionist (+€150, plus €750 one-off). Prices excl. VAT.
hero.noscript: Without JavaScript the scale doesn't move. For every answer you can still read what it means, and below you'll find exactly how we weigh.

q.legend: How often do you miss a call {werk}?

opts.label: Every day, now and then
opts.eff: Against that we put the AI receptionist: +€150 a month on top of Online Growth, plus €750 one-off. She answers your phone, day and night.

opts.label: A few times a week
opts.eff: Do your customers mostly call? Then we'll discuss the AI receptionist together; she isn't counted in the price. Otherwise your phone is part of your inbox, at no extra cost.

opts.label: Hardly ever
opts.eff: No AI receptionist needed. Saves you €150 a month and €750 one-off.

opts.label: No idea
opts.eff: Then we don't count them. Before the demo, try counting your missed calls for a week.

q.legend: Do messages come in that you can't answer straight away?
q.hint: Through your site, WhatsApp, Instagram or Messenger.

opts.label: Every day, also in the evening and at weekends
opts.kort: every day, also evenings and weekends
opts.eff: Questions while you're closed. On the other side we put the AI chatbot: +€50 per month. It answers questions and books appointments, 24/7.

opts.label: Every day, mostly during opening hours
opts.kort: every day, mostly during the day
opts.eff: Do your customers book by message? Then we recommend the AI chatbot (+€50 per month). Otherwise we'll discuss it together: during the day you can also reply later from your inbox.

opts.label: A few a week
opts.eff: You answer those yourself from one inbox. No AI chatbot needed. Saves €50 per month.

opts.label: Hardly ever
opts.eff: No AI chatbot needed. Saves €50 per month.

q.legend: What often slips through the cracks now?

opts.label: Asking for a review
opts.eff: Included in Online Growth: 2 hours after every appointment a review request goes out by text or email, automatically.

opts.label: Making invoices and chasing payments
opts.eff: Included in Online Growth: online payments, an automatic invoice after every payment, and reminders for unpaid invoices.

opts.label: Reminding customers of their appointment
opts.eff: Included in Online Growth: follow-up and reminders run by themselves through your workflows.

opts.label: Following up WhatsApp, Instagram and email separately
opts.eff: Included in Online Growth: WhatsApp, Instagram, email, text and phone in one inbox.

opts.label: Nothing, that's already fine
opts.eff: Already fine. Doesn't count.

opts.label: More customers who find me and book
opts.kort: more customers who find me and book
opts.eff: Included in Online Growth: a fast website, your Google profile, campaigns and landing pages.

opts.label: Everything in one place, fewer separate tools
opts.eff: Included in Online Growth: website, calendar, inbox, campaigns and payments on one platform, for one monthly price.

opts.label: My business runs well: I want to learn to use AI myself
opts.eff: That's AI Consulting: we teach you to use AI in your own work, for €200 a month (introductory price). It doesn't go on the scale.

opts.label: My business has a team: I want AI employees who share the work
opts.eff: That is EML AI Team: a custom AI team, starting with a free analysis. Packages from €3,500 + €750 a month. It does not go on the scale.

items: 30 minutes, without obligation. Bring your weighing slip and we'll start where you left off.
We build and set up everything. You don't have to build anything yourself.
No annual contract. You pay per month.

items.q: Do I have to take everything?
items.a: Online Growth is one package with all nine parts, for €150 per month, excl. VAT. We only recommend the AI chatbot and the AI receptionist when your answers call for them.

items.q: Can I take an add-on without Online Growth?
items.a: No. The AI chatbot and the AI receptionist always come on top of Online Growth. That's why there are only four prices: €150, €200, €300 and €350 a month, excl. VAT. With the AI receptionist there's a one-off €750 on top.

items.q: What if I don't need anything?
items.a: Then we'll say so. Sometimes our advice is: nothing right now. The demo stays free and without obligation.
No. It's a first estimate based on your answers. In the free 30-minute demo we look at it together.
We don't have reviews yet. That's why we'd rather show what we measure, like at Clinic3D in Hasselt.
They stay in this tab on your device. The package finder doesn't send anything. Your weighing slip only leaves your device if you copy it, share it or send it on WhatsApp.

items.q: How quickly is everything up and running?
items.a: You're usually live within 14 days. Online Growth is cancellable monthly.

items.q: And if my business has a team?
items.a: Then EML AI Team may fit: a custom AI team, with AI employees per department. The analysis is free. Packages start at €3,500 one-off + €750 a month, excl. VAT, with a fixed 12-month contract. At the last question, choose: AI employees for my team.
